title: Pepito’s New Ride: Powered by FYI Yachts, Curby Corp & Total Insurance
description: FYI Yachts has teamed up with the Miami Marlins, Curby Corp, and Total Insurance to bring a new level of energy to LoanDepot Park with the donation of a custom ATV—now driven by fan-favorite mascot Pepito. This exciting partnership is just the beginning of a meaningful collaboration rooted in community, fun, and South Florida pride.
html:
FYI Yachts is excited to share the beginning of a vibrant new partnership with the Miami Marlins—one that brings community, fun, and local pride together in a unique way. Teaming up with Curby Corp and Total Insurance, we recently donated a custom ATV to the Marlins to help bring even more energy and excitement to the ballpark experience.

This dynamic vehicle is already turning heads at LoanDepot Park, especially with Pepito, the Marlins’ beloved mascot, behind the wheel. Whether he’s zipping across the field to greet fans or revving up the crowd to support the team, Pepito and the ATV are quickly becoming an iconic part of game day entertainment.

We’re incredibly grateful to the Marlins organization for allowing us to be part of something so special. This donation is more than just a gift—it’s a symbol of the community spirit we value deeply at FYI Yachts.

This is just the start of what we believe will be a lasting and meaningful collaboration. We look forward to growing this relationship and creating more memorable moments together—on and off the field.

Stay tuned for what’s next as FYI Yachts continues to connect passion, partnership, and purpose in everything we do.
